children: BioCardia will present CardiAMP regulatory progress, the ongoing CardiAMP HF II pivotal trial, and Helix and Heart3D platform updates at the H.C. Wainwright conference.
CEO Peter Altman will present at H.C. Wainwright conference Sept 14–16, prerecorded available Sept 11.
BioCardia plans a Shonin pre-market submission to Japan's PMDA for CardiAMP in Q4 2026 based on three completed trials.
FDA meeting minutes indicate CardiAMP HF II may support a PMA for ischemic heart failure in the U.S.; trial is actively enrolling.
Company intends a Q3 2026 follow-on De Novo pre-submission for the Helix delivery catheter based on FDA advice.
Advancing Heart3D fusion imaging toward potential FDA 510(k); combined Helix/Heart3D could broaden cell, gene and protein therapy applications.
